    <p>
      The Standard Model Lagrangian is not a single inspired guess. Its broad
      structure follows from the chosen fields, Lorentz invariance,
      renormalisability, and local \(SU(3)_c\times SU(2)_L\times U(1)_Y\)
      gauge symmetry.
    </p>
